title: EP Aquarii: A New Picture of the Circumstellar Envelope
question: Re-evaluate the morpho-kinematics of the circumstellar envelope of EP Aquarii—specifically the origin of the high-velocity wings, the formation and spiral nature of the equatorial density enhancement, the bipolar outflows, and the western depression in SiO(5-4) emission—using new analyses of archival ALMA CO(2-1) and SiO(5-4) data.

data.sensitivity: 1.25 mJy beam^-1 (2016); 0.65 mJy beam^-1 (Combined); 1.0 mJy beam^-1 (TM0 CO(2-1)), 1.34 mJy beam^-1 (TM0 SiO(5-4))

what.value: Combined 2016 and 2019 ALMA data cubes for CO(2-1) and SiO(5-4)

evidence.quote: The combined data are obtained from Homan et al. (2020a) via the CDS (http://cdsarc.u-strasbg.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/642/A93).

recipe.goal: Reduce and image high-resolution 2019 (TM0) visibility data separately
recipe.method: Merge June 5 and June 14, 2019 observations with equal weights, group into velocity channels, and clean using natural weighting with circular masks without continuum subtraction or self-calibration.
key_parameters: Channel widths: 0.95 km s^-1 for CO(2-1), 0.34 km s^-1 for SiO(5-4)
Image size: 2000 x 2000 pixels covering ±4 arcsec; natural weighting
Cleaning mask radius: 1 arcsec for CO(2-1), 2 arcsec for SiO(5-4)
assumptions: Systemic star velocity of -33.6 km s^-1

recipe.goal: Characterize the inner and outer Equatorial Density Enhancement (EDE) morpho-kinematics
recipe.method: Extract Doppler velocity spectra and Vz vs omega position-velocity (PV) maps in 100 mas concentric rings (100-500 mas) for CO(2-1) and SiO(5-4); compute mean and rms of Vz over |Vz| < 2 km s^-1 in 10 deg x 100 mas (omega, R) bins across 1.2 < R < 5.2 arcsec; average central channels (-0.75 < Vz < 0.53 km s^-1) to correct for EDE plane tilt and evaluate spiral vs offset-circle geometry.
key_parameters: Inner rings: 100 mas width from R = 100 to 500 mas
Outer EDE region: 1.2 < R < 5.2 arcsec, |Vz| < 2 km s^-1, bin size 10 deg x 100 mas
assumptions: EDE inclination of 10 deg with respect to the plane of the sky and rms flaring angle of ~15 deg

recipe.goal: Analyze polar outflow arcs and latitudinal velocity dependence in CO(2-1)
recipe.method: Inspect 51 velocity channels (-8.2 to +8.2 km s^-1) over 1.2 < R < 5.2 arcsec in x-y, omega-R, Vz-R, and Vz-omega projections; divide brightness by power-law radial fits to test for radial-decline bias; compare Vz vs R maps in narrow position angle wedges against parametric latitudinal expansion velocity curves f(alpha) = sin^n(alpha).
key_parameters: 51 frequency channels (-8.2 < Vz < +8.2 km s^-1), radial range 1.2 < R < 5.2 arcsec
assumptions: Thin radially expanding shell geometry where Vz = V sin(alpha) and R = r cos(alpha)

recipe.goal: Quantify SiO(5-4) inhomogeneity, the western and northern emission voids, and correlation with CO(2-1)
recipe.method: Compare observed SiO(5-4) intensity in 0.5 < R < 2.3 arcsec to the smooth normalized product U(R) x S(Vz) in red and blue hemispheres; construct Vz vs omega maps in 100 mas inner rings and Vz vs R maps integrated over 240 deg < omega < 300 deg (western void) and 280 deg < omega < 360 deg (northern void) for both SiO and CO; normalize brightness by power-law fits A*R^b in 0.7 < R < 2.0 arcsec (excluding 240 < omega < 300 deg in blue) and perform linear correlation fits between normalized SiO and CO maps.
key_parameters: Smoothness test volume: 0.5 < R < 2.3 arcsec, 0 < |Vz| < 8 km s^-1
Void position angle sectors: 240 deg < omega < 300 deg (western) and 280 deg < omega < 360 deg (northern)
Correlation region: 0.7 < R < 2.0 arcsec (excluding 240 deg < omega < 300 deg in blue-shifted hemisphere)

recipe.goal: Separate and quantify the two components of the high Doppler velocity wings
recipe.method: Integrate TM0 SiO(5-4) spectra in 20 mas wide annular rings from mean radius 10 mas to 390 mas; measure the full width at 10% of maximum (FWTM) as a function of R; extrapolate the red-shifted spectrum edge down to continuum level in the combined data to measure V_max as a function of R and omega; construct |Vz| vs R PV maps and intensity maps in 8 < |Vz| < 12 km s^-1 and 12 < |Vz| < 20 km s^-1.
key_parameters: 20 annular rings of 20 mas width, mean radii from 10 mas to 390 mas; FWTM threshold at 10% of maximum

score_reason: The combined FITS cubes are directly downloadable from CDS, the raw ALMA datasets are public, and the imaging settings (pixel size, image dimensions, channel widths, natural weighting, mask radii, no continuum subtraction, no self-cal) and mathematical definitions of all slices and fits are clearly specified, lacking only the specific software name and clean stopping criterion.
rediscovery_reason: Public FITS cubes on CDS and public ALMA raw data allow direct reproduction of all PV diagrams, annular spectra, FWTM exponential fits, and CO/SiO correlation slopes through straightforward cube slicing and 1D fitting.
